text: You don’t need another dashboard. Your day needs one decision, not more charts.
Sensei opens on Today: one finding that needs you, where it came from, and one action. A few supporting insights and your recent sessions sit underneath.
Every part of Sensei works the same way. It observes, forms one finding, and offers one action: apply, review or dismiss.
Early on, it just listens. Until there’s enough to go on, it offers no advice at all.
Insights sort into now, soon and settled. Each asks for one decision with a sensible default.
And you can see what it adopted for you: each memory with what it is, why, how it applies, and how often it was used.
Sensei. One thing today, with its receipt.
